relation: Actuation addresses a gap between asking AI to work and understanding the agency that actually acts. A person needs to know who is acting, in which World, with what purpose and permission, and how the experience of that work returns. As work moves between models, harnesses, sessions and collaborating Agents, these relationships should stay inspectable.
